idea: Our community garden group needs something to help us organize stuff better. People keep missing things and it causes friction.

problem: Honestly the friction is about the shared chores: watering and composting get skipped because nobody knows whose week it is.
The missed things are mostly announcements; they get buried in a group chat.
user: About twenty plot holders, mostly retirees on phones; two coordinators who set schedules.
workflow: A coordinator sets the rota each season; members check what is theirs this week and mark it done; announcements get posted where people actually see them.
success: If watering stops getting skipped and people stop claiming they never saw the announcement, that is a win.
constraints: There is no budget at all and no one technical to maintain anything complicated.
